findings.text: The task ends with `just test-scheduled-checks`, but "Checks and their cadence" in `CLAUDE.md` says to run `just test-scheduled` once at the end of the task. Fix: say in the task that `test-scheduled-checks` is used because it skips the mutant suites (which run in CI), or change it to `just test-scheduled`.

The status file says implementation waits for the query-source parts and the coordinated FK atom interfaces, but it does not link their task and status files. Both exist: `plans/20261024-query-sources.*` and `plans/20261024-foreign-key-atoms.*`. Fix: link those two task files in the prerequisites paragraph.
